seoTitle: Hide or Unhide Purchase History on eBay
metaDescription: eBay doesn't allow permanent deletion of purchase history, but this guide shows how to hide, archive, and later unhide orders on web and mobile.
intro: eBay doesn't let you permanently delete purchase history — that record stays with your account regardless of what you do in the interface. What you can do is hide individual orders from your default view, which keeps a shared account tidy, protects gift purchases from being noticed, and cleans up years of accumulated clutter without actually erasing anything eBay itself keeps on file. This guide walks through where the Purchase History menu actually lives, how hidden orders get tucked away, and where to find them again if you ever need to unhide one.

steps.heading: Open Purchase History from the My eBay menu
steps.body: From any page on eBay, click My eBay in the top right to open the dropdown, which lists Summary, Recently Viewed, Bids/Offers, Watchlist, Purchase History, Buy Again, Selling, and several other account sections. Purchase History is the one that matters here — it's a separate page from Selling or Bids/Offers, and it's where every order you've ever placed shows up by default before any hiding happens.

image.caption: The My eBay dropdown menu, with Purchase History listed alongside Watchlist, Buy Again, and Selling.

steps.heading: Find the action to archive or hide an order
steps.body: Inside Purchase History, each order row has an Actions column on the right with options like Leave feedback and Track package, and a More actions dropdown that expands to reveal additional choices for that specific order. Below the order list, checkboxes next to each purchase let you select one or several orders at once, with Add note and Archive buttons appearing once something is selected — Archive is the option that moves an order out of your default view.

image.caption: A purchase in the Purchases list, with checkboxes and an Archive button below for removing selected orders from the default view.

steps.heading: Understand what "hidden" actually means here
steps.body: Archiving or hiding an order doesn't touch eBay's own copy of the transaction — it changes what shows up when you look at your own account, nothing more. Sellers, buyers, and eBay's systems still have the full record for things like returns, disputes, and tax purposes, so hiding is a privacy and organization tool for your view, not a way to make a purchase disappear from eBay's servers.

steps.heading: Check the Show hidden tab to see what you've archived
steps.body: Purchases has a row of filter tabs across the top — All Purchases, Show hidden, Processing, Unpaid items, Returns & Canceled, Ready for feedback, and Shipped. Clicking Show hidden switches the page to display a Hidden Items section instead of the normal purchase list, confirming there's a distinct, separate view specifically for anything you've archived rather than those orders just disappearing.

image.caption: The Purchases page with the Show hidden tab selected, displaying a dedicated Hidden Items section separate from the main order list.

steps.heading: Unhide an order when you need it back
steps.body: Once you're viewing Hidden Items, any order that was previously archived appears there with its own action to restore it — selecting an order and choosing Unhide (or the equivalent restore action) moves it back into your main All Purchases view. This works in reverse exactly the way archiving does: select, then apply the action, and the order returns to normal visibility without any loss of order detail, tracking info, or seller messages.

steps.heading: Use the same process on the mobile app
steps.body: The hide and unhide flow mirrors what's on the desktop site inside the eBay app — Purchases has the same filter tabs including a hidden or archived view, reached from the Account or Activity tab. If you manage a shared account from your phone as often as a browser, you don't need to switch devices just to archive or restore an order; the same underlying account data drives both.

faq.question: Can I permanently delete purchase history on eBay?
faq.answer: No, eBay doesn't allow permanent deletion, but you can hide or archive orders from the Purchases page so they no longer appear in your main view.

faq.question: How do I unhide a purchase I archived?
faq.answer: Go to the Purchases page, click the Show hidden tab to open Hidden Items, and use the unhide or restore action on the order to move it back to your main list.

faq.question: Does hiding an order delete it from eBay's records?
faq.answer: No, hiding only changes what's visible to you. The order remains on file with eBay for the seller, for returns, and for eBay's own records.

faq.question: Can I hide gift orders from a shared account?
faq.answer: Yes — archiving a gift purchase moves it out of the default Purchases view, which is exactly the use case eBay's Show hidden tab is built for.

faq.question: Does this work the same on the mobile app?
faq.answer: Yes, the eBay app has the same Purchases filters, including a hidden/archived view, so you can hide and unhide orders from your phone.
